experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hike
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route through the heart of Torres del Paine National Park. The trail winds through stunning valleys, past glacial lakes, and offers breathtaking views of the iconic granite towers. You'll traverse the Valle del Francés, Glacier Grey, and the base of Las Torres, experiencing the full spectrum of Patagonian wilderness.
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Central Circuit

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Wake before dawn and hike to the iconic viewpoint at the base of the three granite towers. The 8-9 hour round trip trail ascends through lenga beech forests and glacial moraines to reveal the legendary towers reflected in a turquoise lagoon. The sunrise light painting the towers in shades of gold and pink is one of Patagonia's most unforgettable natural spectacles.
experiences.location: Las Torres Base, Eastern Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Kayaking Expedition
experiences.description: Paddle through iceberg-dotted waters on a guided kayaking tour alongside the massive Grey Glacier, one of Patagonia's most impressive ice fields. Navigate between floating blue-tinted icebergs calved from the glacier face while your guide explains the glaciology and ecology of this remote wilderness. A truly immersive way to experience the raw power of Patagonian ice.
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Western Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Condor Watching Trek
experiences.description: Hike through the dramatic Valle del Francés, a glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers and towering peaks. This full-day trek offers prime opportunities to spot Andean condors soaring on thermal currents above the valley. The trail passes through native lenga beech forest and open meadows, with panoramic views of Paine Grande and the Cuernos del Paine massif.
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Central Sector, Torres del Paine

experiences.name: Lago Nordenskjöld Shoreline Trek & Puma Spotting
experiences.description: Join a small-group guided nature walk along the shores of the vivid turquoise Lago Nordenskjöld, one of the park's most photogenic lakes. An expert naturalist guide leads the group through prime puma territory, with excellent chances of spotting guanacos, foxes, and the elusive Patagonian puma. The route offers stunning reflections of the Cuernos del Paine in the lake's glassy surface.
experiences.location: Lago Nordenskjöld Shoreline, Southern Sector, Torres del Paine
